title: Indoor bike, aerobic flush, zero eccentric
coachNotes: Rain arrives and the 3x12 threshold session was absorbed into Wednesday, so this is deliberately not a replacement for it. Bike because it buys aerobic minutes with no eccentric cost on quads that took 1000m of descent 24 hours earlier. Cadence high, resistance low, nothing that feels like a workout. Strength after: single-leg step-downs, glute med, Copenhagen. That is the actual training on this day. Garmin expect 50-80.
